meta.summary: Hides Relic Radio's subscribe and support boxes, top posts and social icons; blur or hide show artwork in sliders and posts
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, iPhone UA 390x844 in headless Chrome, relicradio.com home page (a WordPress site with the Avada theme and Jetpack widgets). Counts are `querySelectorAll` on the rendered DOM saved from that load (scripts then switched off to evaluate); see the per-rule counts in the playbook. Selectors are WordPress and Avada class names (`widget_blog_subscription`, `widget_top-posts`, `fusion-social-networks`), readable and stable across posts. None depend on English text.

NOT verified: show and episode pages, the player, search results, desktop layout, comments (disabled on the pages checked), and the original cookie, ad and app-banner rules (nothing on the home page matches them).
